phase3_findings.description: a head-branch-query-selected resume PR carrying no closing linkage is terminally DECISION_BLOCKED — the outcome the change exists to remove
'gather all three or none' had no mechanism: a partial gather was indistinguishable from a genuine refutation
surviving mutant: `is True` -> `!= False` on the closes-issue conjunct stayed green (no absent-field arm)
derived payload keys provenance_source / pr_linkage_vouches asserted by nothing
the widened routing prose (the only thing making the helper run on the landed-resume arm) was unguarded after the negative-control pin was retired
documented falsehood: the new identity-checked flags were said to 'fail open' on a quoted "false"; they fail closed
self-contradicting diff: the preflight header said the threat model is 'stated once ... do not restate it here' while the same diff shipped it in three places
overstated universal 'every landed resume' in two files; a workpad-vouched landed resume is unaffected
the new assert_pin_unique protects secondary rationale prose, not behavior or a machine-consumed contract
stale run.sh comment (g) forward-references the pin this same diff deleted
the shipped prose advertised a branch-mismatch screen that is unreachable by construction on the landed-resume arm
open_pr_branch was the one gate operand with no typed refusal, so a malformed value failed closed silently
§1.4.0.5's arm gate read shell variables the same file argues do not survive across fences
JSON null vs omitted untested for the new operands; no positive control carrying them
a PR-vouched stop reports the reason slug 'matching-verdict-tip-unreachable' naming a verdict the code synthesized rather than observed
precedence asserted at one workpad-verdict shape only
adding isCrossRepository to both --json lists creates a whole-query failure mode on a gh too old to know the field; no documented version floor

fix_decisions.claim_text: give the PR-vouched tip-unreachable stop its own reason slug
fix_decisions.evidence: a new reason slug is an addition to an enumerated value set, arming the §2.3.0b doc-mirror reconciliation sweep across the phase file and two docs; the payload already carries provenance_source in the same object, so the attribution is available at zero vocabulary cost

fix_decisions.claim_text: assert precedence at a second workpad-verdict shape
fix_decisions.evidence: the existing both_wp_precedence arm already kills the PR-precedence mutant (a PR-precedence implementation returns VALIDATED_RESUME there instead of divergent-nonexistent); a second point adds a subprocess without a distinct mutant

fix_decisions.claim_text: document or guard a gh version floor for isCrossRepository
fix_decisions.evidence: pre-existing class — the same two queries already request closingIssuesReferences with no floor, and lib/preflight.sh checks gh presence only; isCrossRepository is long-standing in gh 2.x. Recorded as an unverified boundary rather than fixed here

shadow.reason: single-pass inline review driven from /devflow:implement Phase 3.3; the five-agent Phase 3 roster ran with full coverage, but no separate post-fix shadow fan-out was dispatched
